summary: cisco.mso deprecated many mso_* modules that no longer work on newer Nexus Dashboard/NDO releases (backup, backup schedule, DHCP option/relay policies, label, remote location, role, cloud-specific site selector and VRF region modules), all to be removed in v4.0.0, with ndo_* replacements for DHCP policies.
questions: Why does mso_backup stop working on Nexus Dashboard 3.2?
Which cisco.mso modules will be removed in 4.0.0?

answer_card.title: cisco.mso deprecated modules (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
Deprecated, removal in **cisco.mso 4.0.0**:

- `mso_backup`, `mso_backup_schedule`, `mso_label`, `mso_role`: not functional on ND 3.2+ (NDO 4.4+).
- `mso_remote_location`: not functional on ND 4.0+ (NDO 5.0+).
- `mso_dhcp_option_policy` (+ `_option`) → **`ndo_dhcp_option_policy`**; `mso_dhcp_relay_policy` (+ `_provider`) → **`ndo_dhcp_relay_policy`** (old ones not functional on NDO 4.0+).
- Cloud-specific modules (`mso_schema_site_anp_epg_selector`, `mso_schema_site_contract_service_graph_listener`, `mso_schema_site_external_epg_selector`, `mso_schema_site_vrf_region*`): unsupported on ND 4.x (NDO 5.x).
